2.Description:
I write this fast, so forgive the shaking hand. You saw the portal open today. That was no accident. Someone out there still hunts your father, and they follow me to find him. Every day I stay under this roof, their eyes drift closer to you. So I go, and the eyes go with me. Be angry at me. You earned it. Eat well. Sleep enough. Show this letter to no one. I have loved you since before your first breath. I mean it plain.
Marta
2.Name: Marta's Letter
